content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Also HSQC maybe. The cheapest is IR? Carbonyl detection via IR is straightforward. Use ir_spectra tool. Then interpret if carbonyl stretch present. Could also use carbon NMR to see peaks in carbonyl region. Probably IR is cheaper. Let's call ir_spectra.
